items.body:
# Codify Mailbag and Flight Runway as Evergreen Permanent Boards

Codify The Mail Bag and The Flight Runway as permanent, evergreen boards that we fill on demand.

Key architectural points:
- Evergreen boards: Mail Bag (has note-level archive already) and Flight Runway (lives on roadmaps/plans, doesn't need board archive).
- Ephemeral exploration boards (like Grill Labs, Spikes, Deep Research) get archived to `.agents/pipeline/boards/archive/` and pruned during `/update-docs --deep` sweeps to harvest insights/anti-patterns into docs and prevent archive bloat.
- Permanent footer links for instant access: `[ 📬 Mailbag ]` and `[ 🛫 Runway ]`.
- Header controls: Add button to grab new incoming mail on demand.
- Re-sequencing: Add re-sequence / rejigger controls on boards to adjust card order on the fly.

items.body:
# Interactive Stream-of-Consciousness Feedback & Live Reading Notes Protocol

## Core Intent
Codify an interactive pair-programming mechanism that allows the developer to capture incremental, stream-of-consciousness reactions as they read long architectural teardowns (PCDAs, specs, audit reports) before reaching discussion, without losing thoughts or feeling constrained by linear reading.

## Proposed Mechanism
1. **Live Reading Note Capture**: Developer reads long dialectics section-by-section and dumps gut reactions as they read ("presentation notes mode").
2. **Non-Judgmental Buffer**: Agent explicitly buffers and reconciles incremental user feedback against later sections without patronizing or dismissing early reactions.
3. **UI Sidecar Tooling**: Potential future N'kai widget or chat command (`/stream-notes` or inline margin notes) allowing paragraph-level reactions.

## Action Route
Approve -> document protocol in docs/history/vibe_coding_field_guide.md and AGY prompt rules.

items.body:
# Mega-Vault Consolidation & Scoped Vault Enclave Architecture (Zettelkasten)

## Core Intent
Architectural blueprint for consolidating multiple fragmented Obsidian vaults into a single unified personal knowledge base (PKB / Zettelkasten), restricting the developer AI tooling harness to a scoped sub-enclave (`TheKlangVault/New Klang City/` or similar) while providing unified global access and pre-migration health scanning for plugins/cruft.

## Proposed Mechanism
1. **Single Unified Obsidian Vault**: Merge multi-vault sprawl into one unified Zettelkasten, increasing daily usage and cognitive cohesion.
2. **Sub-Enclave Boundary**: Restrict TheKlangSuite/N'kai AI harness strictly to a scoped folder (e.g. `vault/New Klang City/`) so agents never touch or leak personal/creative notes.
3. **Vault Pre-Migration Health Scanner**: Tooling script to audit external vaults before merge (checking for broken plugins, bloated cache, circular links, and filename hazards).

## Action Route
Approve -> author migration RFC in TheKlangResearch and design enclave boundary.
